input.rationale: The only grant of rights to us is Section 1.4 (access to, and the right to use, HDI's hosting system and HDI's software and Content administration tools). It runs to "the Company" alone — "Company" is defined in the preamble as The Deerskin Companies, Inc. only, so affiliates are not included and there is no path to add them, which fails the fallback element on affiliate coverage. Successor transfer is satisfied on its material terms by Section 10.3, under which the Agreement inures to the benefit of and is enforceable by the parties' successors and assigns without HDI consent, so no change is needed there. The grant is not revocable at HDI's discretion, so this is not walk-away territory; we therefore make the single shortest fallback-level change (affiliates on written notice) and do not press the preferred perpetual/irrevocable and contractor language.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
mappings.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to Company affiliates on written notice
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our licence checklist requires affiliate coverage; Section 1.4 grants access and use rights to the Company alone, so we have added that the Company's affiliates may exercise those rights upon written notice to HDI. Successor transfer is already preserved by Section 10.3.

ops.text: Upon written notice to HDI identifying the entity, the Company's affiliates (any entity controlling, controlled by, or under common control with the Company) may exercise the Company's rights of access and use under this Section 1.4.
